summary: The five-story headquarters of the UCSF Cardiovascular Research Institute, a lab building with an outpatient clinic and a vivarium, opened in 2010; its size is given as about 236,000 sq ft in an Architizer listing (which could not be checked in September 2026) and as 323,000 sq ft by two contractor pages, so it is not settled here.

milestones.text: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings holds a preliminary design review of the Mission Bay Cardiovascular Research Building; the campus reports it is expecting a $100 million cash gift and a matching $50 million gift (bringing the campus close to $180 million in gifts in hand; the minutes give no project budget) and plans to seek full design approval in November 2007

facts.value: SmithGroup with Jim Jennings Architecture; landscape by Andrea Cochran Landscape Architecture
236,000 (Architizer listing credited to SmithGroup, which could not be checked in September 2026); two contractor pages (Tutor Perini; Rudolph and Sletten) give 323,000, so the sources conflict
Cardiovascular research: laboratories, an outpatient clinic and a vivarium on the top floor (Tutor Perini); Architizer's listing, which could not be checked in September 2026, adds 'wet labs'

open_questions: Exact opening month/day not confirmed by a primary source; a specific Nov 1, 2010 date found in one web-search summary was not traceable to a primary document, so it isn't used here.
No openly licensed image was found; none is hosted here.

Images: no plan drawing, elevation or openly-licensed photograph was found for this building specifically. Searched: UCSF Real Estate's Mission Bay campus-site and LRDP pages (realestate.ucsf.edu, which could not be checked); the UCSF 2014 LRDP EIR's CEQAnet filing (SCH 2013092047, whose pre-2016 attachments aren't hosted on CEQAnet itself); a May 2000 Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings design-approval item for an early Mission Bay building (text-only, no figures); the 2008 "UCSF Mission Bay Planning Principles" appendix (a citywide-scale community map, no individual buildings labeled); and a UCSF wayfinding campus map (not an adopted plan, EIR or permit filing, so not eligible as public-record even though found). Not pursued further; the record's own project sources above remain the citation for the building's history.

As of 2026-09-21, a May 2008 Regents item amending this project's budget/financing (to $254,000,000, matching this record's own cost figure) has been found, but the original full-approval item's exact date could not be found; the September 2007 preliminary design review, which is dated and clearly building-specific, is used instead as the earlier milestone.

As of 2026-09-29, the size, cost, architect credits and 'L-shaped' description rest on an Architizer listing that could not be checked; two readable contractor pages (Tutor Perini; Rudolph and Sletten) give 323,000 sq ft, five stories, completion 2010, a $196 million 'contract amount' and the architect as 'SmithGroupJJR', which conflict with 236,000 sq ft and $254 million (the latter matches a May 2008 Regents budget item that could not be re-checked). The September 2007 Regents minutes give no project budget.
